scope: Operational details fixed before new local replay, supplement to Stage 9
source_threshold_stream: P0 equal-spacing trajectories on source regions at the same seed, level and budget; online map features at the evolving estimate, with real live accepted-fix updates
threshold_quantile: 1 - budget, equal weight per source opportunity; ties retained and realised attempt counts reported
target_feedback: Threshold is fixed from the source reference stream; shifted trajectories may change realised rates. Compare at matched actual attempts.
matched_equal_control: P0 default uses every round(1/B)-th frame. Matched controls use the comparator's exact realised count, evenly spaced including endpoints.
matched_predictor_controls: For P4 vs P2/P3, rerun each with an attempt cap equal to the smaller realised count. Prefixes through that cap are unchanged; paired totals must equal the cap.
cache_centres: Exact float64 coordinates, no 25 m rounding; avoids introducing unmeasured cache approximation
outcome_source: A_live until a recorded independent fidelity check permits C_hybrid
oracle: Privileged live look-ahead comparator; only correct fixes attempted, capped at the requested budget. Extra oracle calls reported separately from deployable policy costs.
